method: ImageMagick 7.1.2-34 decodes, rotates (-distort SRT / AffineProjection), compares (compare -metric RMSE) and encodes (WebP). Statistics over the decoded pixels (magick f -depth 8 rgba:-) are aggregated with numpy. Values are 0-255 unless a key says _0_1.
